resources.string: Allows AIO MDM to manage this device (kiosk, apps, configuration, reboot, and remote support).
Lets AIO MDM deliver remote touch and navigation input during a support session.
What the MDM can do here
Green is fully available. Amber works with limits on this device.
Scan to open this device on the dashboard
Make AIO MDM the device owner

Device owner is what lets AIO MDM lock the device to kiosk, install apps silently and apply policy. It can only be set on a freshly reset device with no accounts on it: scan the AIO enrollment QR code during setup (tap the welcome screen six times to open the scanner), or over adb:

Enrollment connects the device to an AIO MDM server. It normally arrives with the provisioning QR code. To enroll over adb, pass the server and an enrollment token from the dashboard\'s enrollment profiles:
It belongs to a restaurant. Please hand it to a member of staff.
